ukberi-tibyan:1-3.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا (١) فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا (٢) فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا (٣)).
The words of the Exalted (ضَبْحًا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَابِحَةً» (by those that run, panting).
(قَدْحًا) is an emphatic maṣdar (absolute object of emphasis), because «الْمُورِي» is the one who strikes sparks («الْقَادِح»).
(صُبْحًا) is an adverbial (ẓarf).

ukberi-tibyan:4-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا (٤) فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا (٥)).
The hāʾ is the pronoun of the valley, although it has not been mentioned here. (جَمْعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «بِهِ» is a ḥāl as well.
It is also said that the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. «وَسَطْنَهُ» (they penetrated into its midst).

ukberi-tibyan:6-8.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ (٦) وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ (٧) وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ (٨)).
(لِرَبِّهِ) is attached (mutaʿalliq) to «كَنُود», i.e. ungrateful for the favours of his Lord. (لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ) is attached to «شَدِيد», i.e. he is intense in his love of amassing wealth. It is also said that it [the lām] is in the sense of «عَلَى». [Translator's note: the printed text reads «بِتَشْدِيدٍ»; the word in the verse is «شَدِيد», and it is translated accordingly.]

ukberi-tibyan:9-11.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ (٩) وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ (١٠) إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ (١١)).
The words of the Exalted (إِذَا بُعْثِرَ): the governor (ʿāmil) of «إِذَا» is «يَعْلَمُ». It is also said that its governor is what the khabar (predicate) of «إِنَّ» indicates, and the meaning is: when [what is in the graves] is scattered forth, they will be recompensed. (يَوْمَئِذٍ) is attached (mutaʿalliq) to «خَبِير». And Allah knows best.
